Emit a Hardened docker run Command

Source: R/container.R
emit_docker_run.Rd

Generates a reproducible, POSIX-quoted docker run command (or argument vector) enforcing network isolation (--network none), read-only root filesystem, dropped Linux capabilities, offline environment flags, pinned image digest, and read-only local model directory mount.

Usage

emit_docker_run(
  spec,
  file = NULL,
  detach = FALSE,
  rm = TRUE,
  format = c("shell", "args"),
  require_pinned = TRUE
)

Arguments

spec

An airgap_container_spec() object.

file

Optional file path to write an executable bash launcher script.

detach

Logical scalar; include -d (detached mode). Defaults to FALSE.

rm

Logical scalar; include --rm to discard ephemeral container state on exit. Defaults to TRUE.

format

Character scalar: "shell" returns a formatted shell command string; "args" returns a character vector of arguments suitable for processx::run("docker", args).

require_pinned

Logical scalar; abort if spec$image_digest is missing. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A character scalar (format = "shell") or character vector (format = "args").

Examples

spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "llama.cpp",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("b", 64)),
  model_dir = "/srv/models",
  model_file = "llama-3.1-8b-q4_K_M.gguf",
  gpu = "nvidia"
)
cat(emit_docker_run(spec))
#> docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m --tmpfs /run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m --gpus all -v /srv/models:/models:ro -e DO_NOT_TRACK=1 -e HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 ghcr.io/ggerganov/llama.cpp@sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb --model /models/llama-3.1-8b-q4_K_M.gguf --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
